violations.why: ISR can reset v_fjord between the rand() store and the read passed to fn_zenith (init() runs in between, no masking).
The value is read at the call and checked, then the ISR zeroes it before line 13 reads it again for the increment.
The increment is a non-atomic read-modify-write; the ISR's write of 0 is lost when the stale value+1 is stored.
The range check is based on a value read at line 8; the ISR changes it before the write at line 13 stores a stale-derived result.
